# BTicino C300X/C100X Integration v3.1.0b1

## Unreleased

Beta. 3.1.0b1 shows every outdoor unit of a station as its own device
([issue #53](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/issues/53)) and
reads the station's own activations, call state and door contacts. It
includes all of **3.0.0**; everything below is new against 3.0.0.

This beta changes devices, entities, services and events. Read **What You
Need to Do** before you update.

The Classe 100X support stays **experimental**
([issue #51](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/issues/51)).

## What You Need to Do

- Make a Home Assistant backup first: going back to 3.0.x needs it (see
  [Update and Downgrade](#update-and-downgrade)).
- Run the agent update Repair. Until it has run, the integration's entities
  are unavailable; with it the devices and entities move to the outdoor
  units.
- Then follow the Repair **Doorbell entities moved to outdoor unit devices**.
  In short:
  - **Blueprints:** select the **Doorbell** input (the outdoor unit's ring
    event, or the **Station ring**) again in automations made from the ring
    blueprints. The calendar reminder takes the **Door station** device, the
    strict phrase decision the **Door** device. Copies you edited are not
    replaced; import them again.
  - **Services:** every service takes a target (one station or one outdoor
    unit, as a device or entity) instead of `entry_id`.
    `answer_doorbell_call` and `hangup_doorbell_call` are now `answer_call`
    and `hangup_call`. `evaluate_ring_analysis` no longer takes `lock_id`.
  - **Removed services;** press the buttons with `button.press` instead:
    `unlock_door`, `stair_light`, `run_device_activation`,
    `stop_doorbell_video`, `reboot`, `reload_gui`,
    `delete_latest_video_message`, `delete_latest_text_memo`,
    `delete_latest_voice_memo`. For a stair light at an address of its own,
    add an activation of type **Stair light**.
  - **Notifications:** the `mode` field is gone and refused. Use `display:
    true`, `tts: true` and `led: true` instead.
  - **Removed entities:** the **Doorbell state** sensor (use the outdoor
    unit's **Call** sensor) and the **Device event** entity (use the event
    entities or `bticino_c300x_agent_event_received`).
  - **Removed event:** `bticino_c300x_action_received`. React to the entity
    that was switched, or to the **Door** and **Stair light** events.
- **Important:** automations that filter `bticino_c300x_agent_event_received`
  on `event_key` (for example `event_key: doorbell_pressed`) no longer fire.
  Replace `event_key` with `event_type` (`event_type: doorbell_pressed`).
- Templates and automations that read these need a change:
  - The **Door unlock** button has `lock_address` (for example `20`) and
    `lock_name` instead of `lock_id`.
  - The doorbell ring event fires when the station has named the calling
    unit (about 0.3 s, at most 1 s). Use the **Station ring** for the
    fastest reaction. Its attributes `event_key`, `event` and
    `video_available` are gone, and so are all other fields of the station
    event it carried along (for example `entry_id`, `event_at` and
    `event_label_<language>`). It carries `call_id`, `unit`, `unit_name` and
    `attribution`; `last_ring_at` and `camera_entity_id` stay.
  - `bticino_c300x_agent_event_received` carries `event_type` (a fixed key
    such as `door_unlock_started`, no longer a translated text), `entry_id`,
    `device_id`, `unit`, `call_id`, `event_at` and `data`. `event`,
    `event_key`, `event_type_key`, `event_name`, `event_value`,
    `event_label`, `event_label_<language>` and the top-level `address` (now
    in `data`) are gone.
  - Activation buttons have `source` `config` or `station`.
- **Activations:** "Light" is now **Actuator**, the station's generic
  actuator (for example a gate opener), pressed and released like a door
  lock. Light activations become Actuator activations with the update. A
  Light activation sent the stair light command: if you used one to switch a
  light, set its type to **Stair light**.
- **Stair light:** **Automatic** now switches the light at the station's own
  address, as its display does, instead of the fixed address `10`.

The entity IDs and history of the doorbell camera, the doorbell ring event
and the door button stay; their displayed names now start with the unit's
name.

## Outdoor Units and Calls

- **Every outdoor unit is its own device** below the station, also when there
  is only one: a **Doorbell ring event**, a **Door** event, a **Door unlock**
  button, a **Call** sensor (`idle`, `ringing`, `answered`, `viewing`, with
  `call_id`), a **Last visitor** image and a camera. The **Doorbell camera**
  is on the default unit and shows the live picture of every unit; the other
  units have a **Camera** with still pictures. The station names its units
  from its own configuration; a unit that is not configured appears with its
  first ring.
- **Station ring:** fires at once with every ring, with the same `call_id` as
  the unit's ring event.
- **Calls have an ID.** `answer_call` and `hangup_call` take an optional
  `call_id`; a call that is over, no longer current or of another unit than
  the target is refused and nothing is sent to the station. With an outdoor
  unit as target, right after a ring they wait until the station has named
  the calling unit (at most about 1 s).
- **The card follows the call:** it shows the calling unit's name, and its
  door button opens the unit that rang.
- **Live view of every outdoor unit:** `activate_doorbell_video` with an
  outdoor unit as target shows that unit in the **Doorbell camera**.
- **Door** event per outdoor unit (`opened`) and **Stair light** event on the
  station (`activated`), whatever opened the door or switched on the light:
  the button, the station or the BTicino app.
- **Door contact** sensor on an outdoor unit wired with one, on while the door
  is open.
- **Station call state** sensor: `idle`, `setup`, `ringing`, `viewing`,
  `waiting`, `conversation`, `answering_machine`, `greeting` or
  `recording`.
- New station events: `call_caller_identified`, `call_answered`,
  `call_view_started`, `call_ended`, `station_call_state`,
  `outdoor_units_changed`, `door_opened`, `door_closed`. Every station event
  reaches Home Assistant whatever entities are enabled; the logbook shows it
  on its device in your language.
- The ring events keep `last_ring_at` across a restart. Right after the
  update it can be empty until the next ring.

Details:
[Classe 300X: Use](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.1.0b1/docs/classe-300x/2-use.md#station-and-outdoor-units),
[Reference](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.1.0b1/docs/reference.md#entities).

## Activations

- The door locks, actuators and stair light that the station is set up with
  get activation buttons, read from the station's own configuration. The
  settings list them under **From the station**, next to the **Manual**
  ones.
- The stair light is released 100 ms after it is switched on, as the
  station's display does.

## Sound and Picture

- **Live video starts sooner** when you open the camera: the agent hands the
  picture on as soon as the station sends it.
- **Live audio and video reach Home Assistant more evenly:** the agent sends
  each packet at once instead of holding small ones back.

## Setup

- A **Classe 300X2** is recognised: setup, the agent reinstall and the SSH
  Repair install nothing on it. It is not supported yet.

## Still Unverified on a Station

The station messages this beta reads were taken from captures of a Classe 300X
with firmware 1.7.19 with one and with three outdoor units. Firmware 2.0.2 and
3.0.6, the door contact and the Classe 100X are checked offline against their
original files. Not tried on a station yet:

- Several outdoor units on a station with this beta: the units, their calls
  and their live view.
- The door contact.
- Firmware 2.0.2 and 3.0.6, and everything on a Classe 100X.

## Update and Downgrade

1. Make a Home Assistant backup and read the beta limitations.
2. Select **3.1.0b1** with Marketplace **Pre-release** or HACS beta versions
   enabled. Stable installations are not switched automatically.
3. Run the agent update Repair, then follow the outdoor units Repair.

3.1 stores the station's entry in a form that 3.0.x cannot load. To leave the
beta, restore the backup made before the update, then run the agent update
Repair; it installs the 3.0 agent again over SSH
([Update and Removal](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.1.0b1/docs/classe-300x/5-update-and-removal.md#going-back-from-31-to-30x)).
